answer: Rewards are escrowed behind a knoll’s pulse-reflecting prism that toggles state only when a ripple from the orchard’s dusk gong arrives. Any Sybil must hand-polish the prism’s facet to match the gong’s sonic ripple profile. Cost per extra identity is 1.8 seconds of micro-lapping and a 0.012 mm^3 prism facet loss, since bulk polishers cannot tune to the gong’s variable harmonic overtones.
